deploy-bot: Heads-up: planned shard cutover tonight 02:00 UTC. Affects api/runtime/console/router. Quiet window 20m, rollback hold 10m. Please ack owners.
sanjay: ack — Ill take runtime kernel pin + KV eviction checks.
emily: ack. Ill pin console schema and publish release notes.
mike: ack. Ill coordinate router weights. Do we want ramp steps or single shift?
sanjay: progressive ramp, 10% steps, watch eviction heat.
tara: QA ack. Ill prepare smoke pack and canary evals.
ops-bot: Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/shard-cutover. Oncall pagers cleared.
emily: release-notes draft ready; will post to #release-notes 30m before window.
mike: router plan: 02:02 10%, 02:04 20%, 02:06 30%, 02:08 40%, 02:10 60%, 02:12 100%.
sanjay: runtime dry-run commands: ```bash
./runtime_ctl set-kernel --profile smallseq --variant quant_kv
./runtime_ctl health-check --wait 60
```
emily: fallback runtime variant = float16_shim-v2 if quantized errors spike.
tara: rollback triggers proposed: p50 >250ms OR error-rate >0.8% sustained 3m OR KV eviction >5% for 2 consecutive 1m buckets.
sanjay: + add CPU throttling >85% on runtime host group.
emily: tagging @sanjay @mike @tara for final ack before schema pin.
sanjay: final ack.
mike: final ack.
tara: final ack.
emily: pinning console schema now and posting notes: https://internal/release-notes/1758889000
deploy-bot: Window open 1758889000. Good luck :rocket:
#automation: 02:02 router -> 10% (automated)
mike: 10% confirmed. runtime metrics stable 60s.
tara: smoke OK.
emily: moving to 20%.
#automation: 02:04 router -> 20%
mike: 20% confirmed. small p50 bump +8ms.
sanjay: eviction 0.7% -> fine.
tara: smoke minor transient, re-run OK.
emily: hold at 20% for 2m to monitor.
ops-bot: Hold enforced. Next step paused.
emike: ack pause.
// manual verification //
emily: cleared to continue, tail settled.
mike: advancing to 30%.
#automation: 02:06 router -> 30%
mike: 30% confirmed. seeing error tail 0.6% -> watching.
sanjay: runtime CPU at 72% group B. ok.
tara: smoke ok. proceed?
emily: proceed to 40%.
#automation: 02:08 router -> 40%
mike: 40% confirmed.
emily: moving to 60%.
#automation: 02:10 router -> 60%
mike: 60% confirmed. eviction 1.5% < threshold.
sanjay: still watching KV dashboard.
emily: moving to 100% and beginning unpin window.
#automation: 02:12 router -> 100%
mike: 100% confirmed. Cutover complete.
ops-bot: Cutover complete. Leave telemetry slices tagged cutover-1758889000 and add postmortem notes.
emily: added smoke logs and runbook tweak (quick-unpin script) to release doc.
sanjay: will propose kernel auto-backoff in follow-up RFC.
tara: attaching QA artifacts.
emike: thanks team. Closing thread. :tada:
